assets.sourceUnits: metres, glTF +Y up, no node transform; bbox differs from webpage advertised dimension
metres, glTF +Y up, no node transform; bbox differs from webpage advertised dimension

low.source: Poly Haven CC0 photogrammetry-derived closed retopology; not Adonis-original scans or unchanged source triangle meshes

parts.crop: Full source projection; triangle XY maximum-depth rasterisation, no rectangular cropped scan panels
parts.retopology: Closed continuous circumferential surface, original scan relief resampled from actual triangle positions; original source connectivity/undercuts are not retained.
parts.authoring: Art-directed circumference, depth, lateral envelope normalization and broad water recess. Source01 carries front relief; source02 carries flanks/rear. Not original scanned solid dimensions.

bottomCap.method: Earcut of true ordered concave XZ bottom ring, no centre fan

parts.closure: Single closed indexed surface before nonindexed merge; no independent convex plates or long scan boundary collars

parts.source: Original manually authored support volume, not scanned surface

departureCut.reason: 35mm clearance from fixed straight departing water ribbon; vertical anchor-to-floor gap is reported separately and does not claim visual water contact.

parts.purpose: Small irregular solid lip integrated into the full-width scanned midledge; physical lower water start support; forward nose tapers back below the crest so the departing straight water route clears the solid.

solidJoins.method: Odd/even ray crossings from unique attachment vertices against the closed main body; positive inside count proves volume overlap, not just a touching silhouette.

upperSource.method: The main closed body itself narrows into the source crest; no separate upper plate geometry

materialOwnership.release: Final returned geometry dispose event, idempotent; merge-input disposal does not release the material.
materialOwnership.borrowedMaps: All maps remain caller-owned; material disposal never disposes textures or input materials.
materialOwnership.wetness: Continuous interpolated per-vertex mask on the same wide scanned surface; no separate wet column mesh.

visibleFaces.sides: Continuous closed scan-derived surface; no exposed scan boundary panels
visibleFaces.rear: Continuous scan02-derived relief; same closed body
visibleFaces.bottom: Below-ground cut and support must be embedded at local y=0

low.mapping: Local finished geometry, no extra Z compression. Do not fit this sample to the 33m cascade envelope; integrator must map these actual attachment points and keep bridge/path space outside the body.
low.limits: Scan-derived continuous closed retopology, not the original scan triangle connectivity or a manifold repair. Projection discards undercuts and missing projected samples are extended. The enclosing macro form and water recess are authored; measured scan relief is resampled. Bottom ground cap must be embedded at y=0. Original mineral type is not verified as limestone.

waterClearanceProof.coverage: Sparse runtime smoke check only: three longitudinal stations and three width lanes. Frozen dense first-metre/full-route and continuous triangle-ribbon checks are recorded separately in scans/validation and manifest sampleExperiment.
waterClearanceProof.method: Ray from water point +12m Z toward -Z against the actual finished rock meshes; positive clearance means water is in front.

waterAttachments.expected: Solid source crest integrated into the same closed scan-derived body
Supported landing on the scanned midledge
Solid irregular authored lip integrated into the scanned midledge
Intentional freefall into the integrator-owned pool at y=0.16; no rock platform is claimed at this point.

denseWaterRouteProof.method: Actual finished meshes, horizontal -Z rays from +12m Z. Arc-length metre spacing and full-width lanes. No-hit is explicit open air, not a positive clearance or a source-support claim.

continuousWaterRibbonProof.method: Clip all actual finished rock triangles against each complete XY water ribbon, minimize affine waterZ(y)-rockZ on every resulting polygon vertex. Covers the continuous planar baseline including spaces between dense ray stations and lanes.

bottomCapProof.method: Actual lowest horizontal triangles: geometric face winding, boundary-versus-sidewall edge equality, reconstructed boundary loops, self-intersections and triangle/outline area comparison.
